title: DC Extended Universe
subtitle: Worlds of Heroes
description: The complete DC Extended Universe in chronological order.

movies.title: Wonder Woman
movies.synopsis: Diana leaves Themyscira during World War I to stop a conflict that threatens all of humanity.

movies.title: Wonder Woman 1984
movies.synopsis: In 1984, Diana faces two new threats while confronting wishes with dangerous consequences.

movies.title: Man of Steel
movies.synopsis: Clark Kent embraces his Kryptonian heritage to protect Earth from General Zod's invading forces.

movies.title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
movies.synopsis: Batman comes to fear Superman's power as a manipulator drives the two heroes toward a devastating clash.

movies.title: Suicide Squad
movies.synopsis: A secret government agency sends imprisoned supervillains on a deadly mission to save the world.

movies.title: Justice League
movies.synopsis: Batman and Wonder Woman unite a team of heroes to defend Earth from the alien conqueror Steppenwolf.

movies.title: Aquaman
movies.synopsis: Arthur Curry must embrace his destiny and challenge for the throne of Atlantis.

movies.title: Shazam!
movies.synopsis: A foster teen gains the power to transform into an adult superhero simply by saying one word.

movies.title: Birds of Prey
movies.synopsis: Harley Quinn joins forces with unlikely allies to protect a young girl from Gotham's ruthless crime lord.

movies.title: The Suicide Squad
movies.synopsis: A new Task Force X is sent to the island of Corto Maltese on a mission with catastrophic stakes.

movies.title: Peacemaker
movies.synopsis: After surviving Corto Maltese, Christopher Smith joins a covert team investigating a lethal extraterrestrial threat.

movies.title: Black Adam
movies.synopsis: An ancient champion awakens in modern Kahndaq and confronts a new generation of heroes.

movies.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
movies.synopsis: Billy Batson and his foster siblings face the Daughters of Atlas as they struggle to grow into their powers.

movies.title: The Flash
movies.synopsis: Barry Allen races through time to save his family, creating a fractured reality with dangerous consequences.

movies.title: Blue Beetle
movies.synopsis: Jaime Reyes bonds with an ancient alien scarab and becomes a hero with extraordinary armor.

movies.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
movies.synopsis: Arthur Curry joins forces with his imprisoned brother Orm to stop Black Manta from destroying Atlantis and the world.
